arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'booking' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'hold',h.booking_id,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status<>'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)) FROM flights f UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config

SELECT 'outbox' AS kind,json_object('id',o.event_id,'booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'status',o.status,'attempts',o.attempts,'booking_status',b.status,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id) AS data FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_booking',json_object('id',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config
